title: Meesho Product Scraper and Price Monitor
description: Scrape Meesho search results with prices, shipping-inclusive landed price, special-offer price, dispatch time, supplier state, product attributes and images. Add a monitor name to track price drops, rank moves and new ratings between runs.

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: One to five Meesho searches such as kurti, saree or bedsheet. Each query is processed in sequence.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum products to save across all queries. One Meesho page holds 20 products, so the default of 20 saves one full page.

minPrice.title: Minimum Price (INR)
minPrice.description: Only keep products priced at or above this value. Filtered runs read extra pages automatically to find matches.

maxPrice.title: Maximum Price (INR)
maxPrice.description: Only keep products priced at or below this value.

minRating.title: Minimum Rating
minRating.description: Only keep products with a rating at or above this value (0 to 5).

includeAds.title: Include Sponsored Products
includeAds.description: Include products marked as ads or sponsored placements.

monitorName.title: Price Monitor Name (optional)
monitorName.description: Reuse the same name on scheduled runs to compare each product with the previous run. Rows then include changeType (new, price_drop, price_increase, unchanged), previousPrice, priceChange, positionChange and newRatings. Use 1-50 letters, numbers, spaces, underscores or hyphens.

onlyChanges.title: Only Save Changes
onlyChanges.description: With a monitor name: save and charge only new products and price changes. Unchanged products are skipped and not charged.

priceChangeThresholdPercent.title: Price Change Threshold (%)
priceChangeThresholdPercent.description: Smaller price moves count as unchanged. Default 1%.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max Pages Per Query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Leave empty to read as many pages as Max Results needs (more when filters drop rows). Set a number to cap pages per query.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Meesho blocks Apify datacenter IPs and direct cloud traffic (HTTP 403), so Residential India is used. Plain Apify Proxy without a group also uses Residential India.
